subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------TR.INFO.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-25 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's argument that 'institutionalized prodding' suppresses inquiry: 'the nature of being is suppressed — which is to say, both creative and functional information routes are perceived in accordance to the established power structure dictates.' (R)IST-F (the reality of isolated focus) is crossed with TR-INFO (trans-information): the question is what isolated-focus produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with trans-information. RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) branches from the main line and carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). TR-INFO is the partner. AFL (affinity alignment) also branches from the main line and leads to TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics), then to ATTN (attraction), then to AF-CON (affinity convergence) and on to (P)INTR (point of idea completion for interpretation).
